label: Pagination
description: Data grid with pagination. Best for a starting point for client side paging over an in-memory list of users.

label: Cell Borders
description: Data grid with cell border. Best for vertical lines between columns as well as rows, with the table set in a Card and the pager below it.

label: Dense Layout
description: Data grid with dense layout. Best for shorter rows and tighter cell padding that fit more records into the same height.

label: Borderless
description: Data grid without table borders. Best for rows with no divider lines, rounded row ends and a colored presence dot on each avatar.

label: Striped Rows
description: Data grid with striped rows. Best for alternating shaded rows with rounded ends that help the eye follow a record across columns.

label: Auto Width
description: Data grid with auto width table layout. Best for columns that size to their content under an auto table layout, leaving each column size unused.

label: Row Selection
description: Data grid with row selection. Best for a checkbox per row plus a header checkbox that selects the current page, held in controlled state.

label: Expandable Rows
description: Data grid with expandable rows. Best for a chevron toggle that opens a short text note under each row, drawn by the column expanded content.

label: Sub Table
description: Data grid with sub table. Best for order rows that expand into a nested grid of line items, each with its own sorting and paging.

label: Column Icons
description: Data grid with column icons. Best for an icon beside each header title, with sorting switched off so every header is a static label.

label: Sortable Columns
description: Data grid with sortable columns. Best for header buttons that step each column through ascending, descending and unsorted, with an arrow.

label: Movable Columns
description: Data grid with movable columns. Best for a header menu with sort entries plus Move to left and Move to right for reordering columns.

label: Draggable Columns
description: Data grid with draggable columns. Best for headers dragged sideways to reorder columns, with the new order applied by an arrayMove handler.

label: Draggable Rows
description: Data grid with draggable rows. Best for a grip handle on each row for dragging it to a new position, with the carried row free to drift sideways.

label: Column Resizing
description: Data grid with column resizing. Best for drag handles on header edges, with Staff stretching into spare width and the Status column locked.

label: Pinnable Columns
description: Data grid with pinnable columns. Best for an 8 column grid that scrolls sideways under a Name column pinned at the start, pinnable from each header.

label: Sticky Header
description: Data grid with sticky header. Best for a header that stays put while a page of 10 rows scrolls inside a fixed height area.

label: Column Controls
description: Data grid with column controls. Best for header menus that combine sort, pin, move and a column visibility list, plus resize handles.

label: Card Container
description: Data grid with card container. Best for a Card with a Users title, an Add User action and the pager in its footer around the rows.

label: Column Visibility
description: Data grid with column visibility controls. Best for a Columns button in the card header that opens checkboxes to show or hide each hideable column.

label: Loading Skeleton
description: Data grid with loading skeleton. Best for skeleton rows drawn from markup set on each column, with an avatar and two text bars standing in for the User cell.

label: CRUD Admin
description: Data grid with CRUD features. Best for a user admin list with search, a status filter popover showing counts, row checkboxes and a row actions menu.

label: CRUD in Frame
description: Data grid with CRUD in frame container. Best for search, a status filter and row actions in a dense stacked Frame titled Team members, with no column resizing.

label: Totals Footer
description: Data grid with column totals footer. Best for one footer row that sums every balance, with its label spanning the columns to the left.

label: Summary Stats Footer
description: Data grid with summary stats footer. Best for two footer rows of statistics: lowest and highest balance, then the average and an active member count.

label: Aggregate Footer
description: Data grid with per-column aggregate footer. Best for footer cells under Balance and Transactions that each show the average over a min to max range.

label: Local Infinite Scroll
description: Data grid with local infinite scroll. Best for a list of 200 in-memory rows windowed by a row virtualizer in a 480px box, with a sticky header and no pager.

label: Remote Infinite Scroll
description: Data grid with remote infinite scroll. Best for feeds that append the next server page as the reader scrolls to the end.

label: Row Pinning
description: Data grid with row pinning support. Best for rows pinned above the rest from a pin column or row menu, kept across pages with a count and Unpin all.

label: Tree Rows
description: Data grid with tree rows. Best for a department, team and member hierarchy with expand toggles, where each page counts top level rows only.

label: Spreadsheet Editing
description: Data grid with spreadsheet editing. Best for a product sheet with range selection, a fill handle, paste, built-in and custom cell editors and a right-click menu.

label: Column Virtualization
description: Data grid with column virtualization. Best for a matrix of 1000 rows by 36 metric columns, virtualized both ways, with edge columns pinned and 8 column jumps.

label: Localized Labels
description: Data grid with localized labels. Best for a language switch for English, German and Japanese that swaps the built-in menu, pager and selection strings.

label: Server-Side Pagination
description: Data grid with server side pagination. Best for records paged on the server, with sorting, search and a status filter sent to the API.
